Here are some relevant articles about cryptocurrency from Wikipedia:

1. **[Cryptocurrency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cryptocurrency)**: A digital asset that uses a distributed ledger technology to secure transactions and control the creation of new units.

2. **[Tether (cryptocurrency)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tether_(cryptocurrency))**: A cryptocurrency that is pegged to the United States dollar, providing stability in value.

3. **[USDC (cryptocurrency)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USDC_(cryptocurrency))**: A cryptocurrency that is linked to the US dollar, designed to maintain a stable value.

Feel free to explore these links for more detailed information!
